text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali receives Lebanese Foreign Affairs Minister Bouez. They discuss need for Arab approach to face Israeli challenges, and bilateral cooperation.
- President meets speaker of Spain's Senate, Juan Ignacio Barrero Valverde. Spain appreciates Tunisia's efforts to support peace.
- About 270 million dinars expected to be invested in fishing sector during ninth development plan 1997-2001.
- Mediterranean tourism exhibition (MIT 97) to be held in Tunis on May 7-11.
- Parliament amends law relating to Industrial Land Agency.
- Lebanese Foreign Affairs Minister Bouez says at end of three-day visit that Lebanon hopes for Arab summit.
- Food and Agriculture Organisation to open North African bureau in Tunis.
- President Ben Ali receives message from Lebanese President Hraoui.
- Tunis main sports association Esperance setting up training centre worth 2.8 million dinars.
